docs.purpose: An operator's at-a-glance read on how the mobile and web apps are behaving. Five tiles show the crash rate over the last day, how many sign-in attempts succeed by method over the last week, how often a viewed lead gets saved, how often the paywall gets clicked, and how much cache-refresh chatter there was. Each tile links out to the deeper analytics tools, and a tile that cannot reach its data source says so with the reason instead of showing a wrong number.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing from the database directly. Every value arrives through one contract: `/api/admin/app-health`. Those contracts' own table reads are recorded on their rows.
docs.under_126: **RE-PROJECT** — it writes nothing and holds no Layer-3 store, so the move is short — the server already assembles the payload and only the rendering is client-side. It renders through the DASHBOARD renderer (tiles that each declare their own contract and degrade independently), reading by reference: `/api/admin/app-health`. Its `owns.components[]` declares `src/components/admin/HealthTile.tsx`.

versioning.why: The only consumer is this page; the payload is Zod-parsed by the route itself before it leaves, so a shape change is one commit on both sides.

inputs.why: Every value arrives through one contract; the page issues no DB query and reads no projection table.

outputs.why: The route exports GET only and the page posts nothing; the tiles are read-only links out to Sentry/PostHog.

state.why: One TanStack query; the page builds its own QueryClient per mount, so nothing it holds survives navigation and there is no Layer-3 store.

staleness.why: staleTime and refetchInterval are both 60s, deliberately aligned to the route's own minute-boundary process cache, so the screen never shows a value fresher than the server has.

session.why: There is no admin Postgres role: classifyRoute sends every /admin/* path down the admin arm, and the real boundary is verifyAdminAuth reading profiles.is_admin on the route. This route calls it on the first line of GET.

rls_class.why: The only table it reaches is profiles (Class C) through the guard; it reaches no data table of its own, and everything it renders comes from Sentry/PostHog over HTTP, so no policy class governs its payload.

checks.why: The route Zod-parses its own assembled payload before returning it, so a drifted tile shape fails at the boundary rather than rendering a wrong number.
A tile that cannot reach its source renders muted with the reason instead of a number — locked by the HealthTile UI suite.
guards.session admin must agree with the contract: GET calls verifyAdminAuth on its first line.

errors.why: A failed fetch renders a page-level error block in place of the grid, and a per-tile failure renders inside the tile; neither throws to a boundary (this route has no error.tsx sibling).

classes.ui: the hook throws on a non-ok response and the page renders its error block

emits.why: Nothing it does is countable: neither the page nor HealthTile imports captureEvent or track, and the route emits Sentry breadcrumbs only (a log, not an event).

offers.why: An internal operator tool renders no sponsored placement; no offers/placements table is reached from any file it owns.

metering.why: Nothing here is billable or quota-bearing: no usage_events / ledger write is reached from this surface or its contracts.

config.why: It consumes no tunable: the thresholds it renders are computed upstream in Sentry/PostHog, and the route reads no logic_variables row.

sharing.why: /api/admin/app-health has exactly one caller in the tree — this page's hook.

limitations.what: touch_target_min_px has no legal answer for a desktop-only admin page
limitations.measured: The schema allows only UNRESEARCHED or an integer >= 44; nothing in this surface declares a 44px floor (grep min-h-[44/h-11 over the two owned files returns nothing), and desktop-first admin has no such rule.
limitations.check_id: none — vocabulary gap, escalated per Spec 128 §4

limitations.what: The page header comment claims a server-rendered src/app/admin/layout.tsx wraps it
limitations.measured: No admin layout file exists anywhere under src/app/admin/.

notes: 'tile_unavailable' is a real per-tile state in HealthTile (status==='unavailable' renders a muted tile with the reason - Spec 30 Sec 2.3), distinct from the page-wide error banner. The page's own header comment claims 'the surrounding admin layout (src/app/admin/layout.tsx) stays server-rendered' - that file does NOT exist; there is no admin layout in the tree. The data hook lives at src/features/admin-app-health/api/useAppHealth.ts (60s poll), outside src/components/ so excluded from files per the stated rule. identity.owner is UNRESEARCHED estate-wide: no owner registry exists in the tree, so naming one would be an invention rather than a measurement. a11y.touch_target_min_px is UNRESEARCHED because its vocabulary (UNRESEARCHED or an integer >= 44) has no member for a desktop-only admin page that declares no floor.

measured_gate.why: classifyRoute('/admin/app-health') matches the admin-pages arm via `pathname.startsWith('/admin/')` -> 'admin'.

programme.why: An admin surface that operates the PLATFORM (users, entitlements, security, tunables, pipeline health) rather than either product specifically.
